behavior: Create one 16 MiB screen-buffer budget per native renderer host. Pass the same owner into all default host-local screen streams, uniforms and glyph draws; terminal quads reserve both host and terminal allowances. Existing global GPU admission still applies.
Keep budget permits with actual allocations through cached bundles and submission retirement. Empty streams preserve budget ownership; normal warm allocation reuse needs no new reservation.

Renderer::recreate_for_device shares the prior host budget during staging and retirement. Main and auxiliary recovery consumers use it; a new window receives its own budget. Constructor refusal rolls back partial uniform allocations.
Expose host reserved-buffer capacity. Required content is not silently omitted: exhausted admission returns through existing renderer/native error paths.
